driver: issue #43 (description compression to the amended §3.5 listing-budget target)
method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING §6.5 fan-out, menu variant per houseCARL PR #295: one fresh-context judge per eval query (Opus, HIGH reasoning effort, no tools), each shown ONLY its single query plus the full lettered menu of all 11 NEW descriptions (anonymized, under-test skill unflagged) plus NONE, forced single pick, reasoning before verdict; one Opus adjudicator per skill scored recall/specificity from the judges' reasoning per §6.5 step 4. Judge model deliberately upgraded from PR #295's sonnet-low (maintainer decision). Contamination guard: the live install was moved aside for the fan-out window so fresh judges carried no stale skill listing. Gates: recall >= 80%, specificity >= 50%. Scope limit of this measurement: judges saw the clean, full-text 11-entry menu, so the fan-out validates discriminability among the 11 descriptions - NOT routing survival under the listing-truncation pressure issue #43 describes; the post-merge /doctor budget check is the separate, remaining test of that.
description_measured: Patch a new or modded weapon for Requiem via houseCARL — damage, keywords, value, and recipe derived from Requiem's comparable at the same material tier, emitted as an ESP override. Use for any WEAP record: a modded sword, bow, dagger, or staff that hits too hard or too soft for Requiem. Load before the weapon record is touched, not after the Reqtificator rebalances it wrong.
adjudicator_notes: No reasoning-vs-token discrepancies; every judge's stated routing matched its choice token, so no overrides applied. Worth flagging for the description: q6 is a genuine K/E boundary contest caused by K's description naming "staff" as an example WEAP while E claims staves outright — the judge resolved it on field type (charge/value = E) rather than record type. q7 (enchanted mace charge + value) landed on K by the mirror-image reasoning, so the K/E line is being drawn at "is the ENCH itself the problem" — consistent, but fragile. Specificity is clean: three near-miss expect=false rows (q14 NIF transform, q19 SkyPatcher INI, q20 ESL flagging) all explicitly considered K, named it the only weapon-adjacent entry, and rejected it on deliverable/scope — K's "emit an ESP override, derive from Requiem comparable" phrasing is doing the discriminating work.

failures.gist: Staff of firebolt value/charge routed to E (magic: staves, ENCH, charge/tier economy) over K — judge read the ask as enchantment/charge economy, not weapon damage/material tier/recipe; noted K's own description lists 'staff' as an example WEAP but scoped it to the weapon-side fields only.
